compressed_items.content: META-PROCESS FRAMEWORK: STRUCTURAL ADAPTATION, CAUSAL PERMEABILITY, AND RECURSIVE EVOLUTION.
README.md frames analysis of systems as transformation processes.
Analyze output-generating mechanisms and their openness to correction rather than outputs alone.
How can a bounded system expand reachable future possibilities while preserving reality's access to the mechanism producing those possibilities?
Reality-observation-representation-compression-search-reachability-action-consequence-feedback-update chain and K_(t+1)=F(K_t,E_t,S_t).
Source-local definitions of K_t, E_t, S_t and F.
System evolution is described as repeated transformation of its representation of reality.
Open-ended adaptation requires reality to retain causal access to future-change revision mechanisms.
P_C ≡ E* -> C_rev and derivative/change-hierarchy/open-versus-closed recursion formalisms.
Definitions of E*, C_rev, directed causal influence, open-endedness, change levels, trajectory and lineage.
Reality may influence self-change rules; closed recursion self-modifies without reality modifying the source of modification; lineage changes the available evolutionary space.
Intelligence is defined as constructing representations that transform unreachable problems into reachable problems, not primarily computation, memory, optimization or search.
Reality -> Representation -> Compression -> Invariant discovery -> Search-space transformation -> Reachability expansion -> Capability.
Representation determines visibility, invariants, operation cost and reachable solutions; T, rho and A are defined locally.
Source gives C(rho,T)<=A as reachability/architecture relation.
Representations are computational geometry transformations and difficulty depends on representation geometry.
Strong intelligence compresses observations into reusable structure; compression creates leverage.
Weak/strong representation and Newtonian mechanics, automatic differentiation graph and learned value representation examples.
Measure future possibility created rather than only magnitude of system change.
G = partial Omega_viable / partial I_stored.
Omega_viable is reachable useful future states; I_stored is useful information structure.
Phi = D_KL(P(X|you)||P(X|not-you)).
Causal influence concerns counterfactual difference in reality; high causal mass introduces unique constraints, information or trajectories.
Causal mass is not alignment; destructive systems may have high causal mass.
Alignment preserves corrigibility under self-modification; adaptive and grounded are defined by experience-driven capability change and reality access to its producing mechanism.
Alignment target is preservation of correction pathways.
partial K_(t+1)/partial E_t != 0; Theta_total=Theta_ext*Theta_int; external/internal corrigibility maps and robustness threshold.
Reality must influence future internal state.
External corrigibility means reality updates K; internal corrigibility means internal subsystems influence K.
Behavioral E->X, epistemic E->K, generative E->G and constitutional E->C_rev permeability levels.
Definitions of behavioral, epistemic, generative and constitutional permeability.
Constitutional permeability is proposed as the open-endedness boundary.
Blindness, saturation, stagnation and drift are defined as distinct adaptive failure modes.
Failure signatures use C decrease, Lambda decrease, Gamma decrease, and capability increase with Theta decrease.
Drift produces a more powerful but less grounded system.
Variation+Selection+Retention and Experience->Pattern extraction->Strategy improvement->Selection->Retention->Repeat.
Memory alone is not intelligence; memory without selection creates accumulation.
Never test concepts directly; separate measurement construction from hypothesis evaluation.
World->Observation->Features->Prediction->Interpretation is contrasted with Concept->Metric->Confirmation.
Reality-linked adaptation is proposed to create better long-term reachable adaptive spaces than environmentally decoupled self-modification.
Grounded J(q,v,Omega) versus decoupled J(q,v), with adaptive-openness formula.
Controlled difference is environmental influence on adaptive topology.
P(t), R(t), E(t) are named as performance, recovery and exploration measures.
Ten-step universal analysis procedure from environment through correction-preserving capability growth.
Reality->Representation->Transformation->Capability->Consequence->Feedback->Transformation-mechanism update.
Power changes what can be reached; adaptation preserves reality's ability to change what the system can become.
Open-ended intelligence is defined as reality retaining causal access to the mechanism of becoming.
README_2.md describes Recursive Adaptive Dynamics (RAD) as a proposed framework evolved from an unspecified research program.
RAD is to be treated as a causal adaptive-systems framework, not a theory of intelligence, consciousness or optimization; simulator purpose is also preserved.
Core RAD questions concern environmental correction, causal ownership of change mechanisms, and whether environmental history can modify adaptation architecture.
RAD proposes open-ended adaptive capacity when reality retains causal access to mechanisms determining future change.
C_open criterion and system/representation/generator/revision transitions.
Definitions of E*, C_rev and openness.
Changing is distinguished from reality changing how the system changes; revision-mechanism change is treated as deepest transition.
Levels 0-3: X update, F update through G, G update through H/Omega, and mathcal-G update through J/Omega.
State, transformation, transformation-selection and constitutional adaptive dynamics are defined separately.
G_t differs from mathcal-G_t; changing a mechanism differs from changing the space of future mechanisms.
Environment->observation->consequence signal->adaptation mechanism->generator->behavior->changed environment; E_t->o_t->s_t->A_(t+1); s_t->Delta A_t.
S_t=(X_t,F_t,G_t,M_t,A_t,Omega_t,q_t,v_t).
Source-local definitions of X,F,G,M,A,Omega_t,q and v.
Reachable future possibility, not capability alone, is central; possible is not reachable.
Capability C_t=|P_reach(t)| and adaptive-openness formula.
P_reach and adaptive openness distinguish accessible mechanisms from mechanisms remaining useful under perturbation.
Normal/evolutionary/higher-order improvement forms including G_m->Gbar_m.
Omega is defined here as rate of improving the ability to generate future improvements, distinct from capability, growth, resources and current performance.
Intelligent/adaptive/self-modifying/high-capability systems may still be closed; open/closed difference is causal topology.
Closure when E* cannot influence C_rev; open and closed C_rev update forms.
Moving island names a system changing internally while its rules of change remain insulated from reality.
RAD states that the framework must remain empirical.
Do not assume hidden intelligence, adaptive capacity, trajectory relevance or beneficial openness.
World->Trajectory->Observable features->Prediction->Interpretation, rejecting Concept->Metric->Confirmation.
CTC asks whether transition trajectories contain predictive information discarded by snapshots.
CTC dataset tuple and conditional-mutual-information test I(z(T);C_future|C_t)>0.
Positive CTC means transition history predicts future competence beyond current competence.
Positive CTC would not establish hidden variable, causality or mechanism; only predictive information.
RVT001 asks whether environmental history can modify the mechanism of adaptation.
Frozen, learner and recursive-learner comparators; I(s;Delta A)>0 necessary condition; recursive viability greater than learner under equal resources success condition.
Frozen F update, learner A(F,s), recursive A_t(F,s), and A_(t+1)=U(A_t,s_t) forms.
Grounded recursion allows reality to reshape mechanism accessibility/viability; decoupled recursion self-modifies without consequence-driven reshaping.
Grounded (q,v) update includes Omega_t; decoupled update omits it.
Predicts similar early performance but higher grounded openness, recovery and viable mechanism space later under novelty.
Structural alignment is reality retaining causal authority over future revision; optimization without correction names capability growth with declining feedback coupling.
Alignment failure signature: capability increases while feedback coupling decreases.
Evolutionary power arises when feedback modifies outputs and the machinery determining future outputs.
Reality must retain causal access to becoming.
Can reality still reach the part of the system that decides what the system can become?

Ten README.md unresolved source fragments: undefined/underspecified C, derivative operationalization, G token relation, Omega_viable/I_stored measurement, KL semantics, Theta measurement, failure-mode C/Lambda/Gamma, q/v/J and E token reuse.

Eleven README_2.md unresolved source fragments: unidentified parent research program, derivative operationalization, H/J, G_m/Gbar_m, Omega token relation, CTC symbols/z/MI protocol, RVT A/U/equal resources, and RAD simulator J.

secondary_audit_views.content: Meta-Process Framework and RAD have strong semantic overlap on the frozen surface, but explicit identity equivalence is not established.
Repeated causal-access propositions across README.md and README_2.md preserve source recurrence but do not establish independent warrant.
CTC, RVT001 and RAD simulator are specification/prediction surfaces on this frozen head; implementation, execution and reported-result standing are not established by those sections.

derived_bounded_absences.content: No executable implementation, dataset, notebook, persisted execution artifact or reported-result document observed on the exhaustive two-path frozen head.
